cleanup: After copying and authenticating all results, the two exact completed experiment units were stopped. Both are inactive with MainPID0; no unrelated session was stopped.
decision: C_exec passes the frozen generic execution-component comparison and is a useful development correction. It is not a canonical ZPD method promotion. Continue to a separately frozen trajectory-conditioned candidate-generation design, not another reweighting of the same history-blind bank.
limits: Repeatedly exposed adaptive development, not fresh Seen/Unseen or confirmatory evaluation.
Public tests may overlap the assessment suite; no assertion of disjoint unseen-test generalization.
C_exec adds public execution work relative to frozen C_joint, so this is not equal-total-compute evidence.
It does not dominate every equally execution-filtered control: lexical_C has8 regressions versus9, while C_exec has3 more AC.
One new regression occurs despite43 prevented. Public preservation is not full-suite preservation.
Independent replay authenticates saved evidence and arithmetic, not physical execution or private-label generation.
No educational learning effect, paper update or LSGen superiority is established.
